name: sentry
description: Read-only Sentry integration over the Sentry REST API. Exposes a local MCP server with list_projects, search_issues, search_logs, get_issue, get_event, and get_issue_tags so crash reports, stack traces, tag breakdowns and structured logs (Explore > Logs, paged and saved as Serilog-style .log files) can be pulled into Kiro while coding. Uses a per-user Sentry auth token. Strictly read-only: it performs HTTP GET requests only and never resolves, ignores, assigns, comments on, or otherwise modifies anything in Sentry.
